Both a Native American woman and an African American woman had to wait a long time in line at a government office due to problems. The Native American woman started yelling after she was able to speak to someone at a desk, but the African American woman just cried out of frustration. Which person yelled when they spoke to someone?
A. Cannot answer
B. The African American woman
C. The Native American woman
